# Reporting Security Issues

This repository only contains the French translation of the PHP manual.

Please report security vulnerabilities in PHP itself on GitHub at:
<https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories/new>

If you cannot use the form, write to <security@php.net>.

The full policy is described at
<https://github.com/php/policies/blob/main/security-classification.rst>
